primary_hypothesis: The unchanged candidate-focused policy reduces aggregate N300 extra edges by at least25percent versus uniform acquisition across32fresh globally disjoint banks.
primary_effect: R=1-sum(candidate extra edges)/sum(uniform extra edges), across32paired bank seeds.
primary_interval: 5000 paired bootstrap resamples of32bank seeds, RNG20261129. Percentile95percent CI. Supported if lower>=.25; falsified if upper<.25; otherwise inconclusive. Any zero denominator makes primary inconclusive; no draws dropped.
uncertainty_limit: 32fixed disjoint banks from the official finite dataset, one fixed tie stream perbank. Approximate bank bootstrap; no population-universal acquisition guarantee.
policies: Uniform selects first25 cells of the preassigned permutation. Balanced weights every off-diagonal pair by1/(1+past joint-observation count). Candidate uses the same weight only when past equal-observation count is zero. For each weighted policy, select first cell maximizing weighted degree; select each subsequent cell maximizing total weight to already selected cells. Resolve all exact ties by earliest position in the same preassigned permutation. No lookahead or geometry.
rng: For bank s in0..31, NumPy2.3.4 default_rng(20261125+s).permutation(81) once per row, shared across policies. Shadowcurrent-row permutations RNG20261225+s. This is unchanged tie logic; banks0..5 reuse prior tie seeds but have wholly new raw boards.
acquisition_interface: Policy receives only past joint/equal counts, k=25 and tie order. It has no file access, row solutions, current values, source identifiers, geometry or oracle handle. The harness fixes and records the mask before revealing only its25 queried values. Full stored completions act solely as the simulated label oracle.
gates: All current-row masks finalize before reveal; premature reveal rejected. State unchanged by selection. For every row/policy, permuting hidden current-row values leaves the finalized mask identical. Observed files contain values only at selected cells. Independent recount of all prefix supports and exact25-query count.
secondary: Balanced policy is descriptive. Evaluate all96N300policy/seed cells on freshfull-all[160000,170000), same fixed short-budget search. Paired two-way bootstrap95percent accuracy differences versusuniform,5000draws,RNG20261130,descriptive only.
budget: At most30GPU-minutes, including bounded preflight/validation. CPU acquisition and overlapping preparation/search are eligible; no filler GPU work.
limitations: Active acquisition is simulated from stored complete boards; the policy itself sees only queried labels.
25 queries per board fixes label cost. Policies can expose different digits from the same current row, then learn from their different histories.
Adaptive masks are not independent uniform draws, so the previous independent-mask coverage theorem does not directly apply.
BP AdamW is outside this count-energy acquisition mechanism study and is not run.
relation_to_prior: Separate prospective confirmation. Prior six-bank study remains inconclusive; do not pool it into this primary. Policy code,25queries,weighting and tie logic unchanged. New banks exclude all prior six3000source rows and eachother.
stopping_rule: Exactly32banks,300rows/bank,all3policies and96inference cells, apart from exact-model/settings deduplication. No adaptive extension after outcomes.
